drivers.intro: Each driver downloads by itself the first time you connect to that engine. Here you can download them ahead (for example, if you'll work offline) or delete the ones you don't use.

drivers.statusNeedsApp: A newer version needs DBine {{minApp}} or later

drivers.statusRestart: Restart DBine to see this driver's new options
